issues.description: Class name mismatch: the UML diagram in problem_statement.md declares the class as 'Course' (line 63) while the provided code in the template and the reference solution defines the class as 'Lecture' (template: src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 3; solution: src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 3). This naming inconsistency between the specification (UML) and the code can confuse students about which class they are expected to implement and verify against the tasks and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Edit problem_statement.md to rename the UML class header from 'Course' to 'Lecture' so the diagram matches the textual description and the provided code. For example change the line 'class Course {' to 'class Lecture {' and keep the listed attributes and methods unchanged. This aligns the specification with the template and solution and removes ambiguity for students.
